verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only a generic AI writing/editing aid and an MCP server for connecting Trello to external AI tools. Neither is a documented Trello capability to draft a project or initiative status update from recent board activity. Both are adjacent features or developer building blocks, so they earn no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have AI draft a project or initiative status update from recent activity
